title: His heart trembled in an ecstasy of fear and his soul was in flight.
html_source:
He has finally realized what his destiny is. It is this epiphany of no longer being uncertain that took over his boyhood that fills him up with elation. However, he’s also scared of maybe flying too close to the sun just like Icarus did.
